title: Approval authority (DOA)
intro: The DOA decides who approves which documents up to which amount. A published version never changes: a change is a new version imported here and approved by the authority under the DOA, never by the person who sends it.
forbidden: This page is for organization admins. If you need it, contact your organization admin.
initialNotice: The organization has no DOA in effect yet. Import the first version and send it as the initial package, with the holders of its positions, for the contract signatory to approve.
empty: No DOA yet. Import the first version from a YAML file with the Import a new version from YAML form.
periodOpen: In effect from {from} until a new version
noReason: No reason for the change was recorded

lint.DOA_LINT_OVERLAP: {documentType}: amounts {band} fall under more than one rule
lint.DOA_LINT_MISSING_DOCTYPE: No rule for {documentType}. Every version needs a DOA-change rule and an authority-change rule.
lint.DOA_LINT_UNRESOLVABLE_GOVERNANCE: Rule {rule}: no approver can be found on the effective date, so nobody could approve policy changes
lint.DOA_LINT_PARALLEL_STEP: Rule {rule}: has a parallel approval step, which is not supported yet

import.title: Import a new version from YAML
import.intro: Use the same shape as the file each version downloads as. Each version needs a new version number. An imported version is a draft and takes no effect until it is sent and approved.
import.reasonHint: Kept in the version’s history and shown to the approver
import.openDraft: Open {name} to check and send it
import.problemsTitle: Nothing was imported. Fix the file as listed and import it again.

issues.NOT_YAML: This is not a readable YAML file. Check the indentation and the colons.
issues.UNKNOWN_MEMBER: No member of the organization has this code. Use the member’s employee code.
issues.DUPLICATE_RULE: This rule code is used by another rule of the same version
issues.MONEY: Write the amount in baht with 2 decimals in quotes, e.g. "20000.00"
issues.INSTANT: Write the date and time with a time zone, e.g. "2026-11-01T00:00:00+07:00"
issues.EXTRA_KEY: Keys the system does not know: {keys}
issues.VALUE: The value is not one the system knows
issues.SHAPE: This does not follow the shape of a DOA file

errors.VERSION_EXISTS: {code} version {version} exists already and cannot change. Use a new version number in the file.
errors.EFFECTIVE_IN_PAST: The effective time of this version has passed. Import it again with an effective time that has not come yet.
errors.LATER_VERSION_SCHEDULED: Version {version} is approved for the same or a later time. It must be withdrawn first.
errors.DOA_LINT_FAILED: This version does not pass the checks. Fix the file and import it as a new version.
errors.NOT_INITIAL: The organization has a DOA already, so this version goes to the approver of the DOA-change rule. Reload the page.
errors.SIGNATORY_NOT_VERIFIED: No contract signatory has been verified by the BCS team. Contact the BCS team before sending the initial package.
errors.POSITION_NOT_IN_DOA: No rule of this version names the position in this row. Remove the row.
errors.UNLISTED_HOLDER: Every current holder of a position this version names must be listed. Missing:
errors.DUPLICATE_SLOT: A position in one department has one holder only
errors.ORG_POSITION: An organization-wide position belongs to the root department only
errors.POSITION: This position does not exist in the organization
errors.DEPARTMENT: This department does not exist in the organization
errors.NO_DEPARTMENT: The organization has no departments yet. Add one before sending.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: Not allowed by separation of duties ({rule}): the sender is never the approver and never lists themselves as a holder.
errors.FILE_MISSING: Choose a YAML file before importing
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {size} KB. A DOA file is usually a few KB; check that you chose the right file.
errors.REASON: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.INPUT: Some information is missing or not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this
errors.NOT_FOUND: This version was not found. Reload the page and try again.
errors.STATE: This version was already sent or its status changed. Reload the page to see its status.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again and repeat this action.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with different details. Reload the page and try again.
errors.BUSY: Another change of the organization is being saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong (reference {requestId}). Try again; if it still fails, give this reference to the BCS team.
errors.NO_APPROVER: No approver of DOA changes can be found. Check that the position the DOA-change rule names has a holder.
errors.REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason is longer than {max} characters. Shorten it and try again.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back from the system. Check your internet connection and press the button again; the same request will not run twice.

detail.readOnly: A version that was sent or published cannot change. To change it, import a new version and send it for approval.
detail.submitIntro: The version is checked again against the organization on its effective date when you send it.
detail.approverError: No approver of DOA changes can be found. Check that the position the DOA-change rule names has a holder.
detail.approverLine: This version goes to {names} for approval under {ref}. The approver confirms their identity again, and the sender can never approve it.
detail.openTasks: {count, plural, one {# approval task waits} other {# approval tasks wait}} under {name}; they keep their route to the end.
detail.effectiveInPast: The effective time of this version ({time}) has passed, so it cannot be sent. Import it again with an effective time that has not come yet.
detail.laterScheduled: Version {version} is approved for the same or a later time than this one. It must be withdrawn first.
detail.errorsTitle: This version does not pass the checks and cannot be sent. Fix the file and import it as a new version.
detail.warningsTitle: Warnings to confirm one by one
detail.warningsHint: Tick each one to confirm you understand its effect
detail.submitted: Sent for publishing. Waiting for {name} to approve.
detail.submittedNoName: Sent for publishing. Waiting for the authority to approve.
detail.diffFirst: This is the first version of {code}, so there is no previous version to compare with.
detail.diffNone: Rules and policies are the same as {name}

ruleFields.approverSla: Approver and time under the SLA

ruleHeaders.approverSla: Approver and time under the SLA

detail.sla: {hours, plural, one {# business hour} other {# business hours}}
detail.boundaryIntro: Which rule applies at each band’s upper edge and 0.01 baht above it

policy.selfApprovalPolicy: When the approver is the requester
policy.collapseDuplicateApprovers: Merge steps with the same approver
policy.stepUpThreshold: Amount from which the approver confirms their identity again
policy.approverMayReceive: The approver may receive the goods
policy.requesterMayReceive: The requester may receive the goods
policy.ESCALATE_NEXT_BAND: Go to the approver of the next band

initial.title: Send the organization’s initial package
initial.intro: The organization has no DOA yet, so the first version goes together with the holders of the positions it names, for the contract signatory to approve with an identity check.
initial.noSignatory: No contract signatory has been verified by the BCS team. Contact the BCS team before sending the initial package.
initial.youAreSignatory: You are the contract signatory, so you cannot send the package you approve. Ask another organization admin to send it.
initial.signatory: The package goes to {name} (the contract signatory) for approval
initial.holdersTitle: Holders of the positions this version names
initial.holdersHint: The list starts with the current holders. Only positions this version names may be listed, every current holder of them must be listed, one holder per position and department, and never yourself. Edit one row at a time.
initial.submit: Send the initial package to the contract signatory
initial.sent: Initial package sent. Waiting for {name} to approve.
initial.sentNoName: Initial package sent. Waiting for the contract signatory to approve.
initial.rowIncomplete: Choose the position, the department and the holder
initial.emptyRows: Nobody is in this package yet. Add the holders of the positions this version names with Add a position holder.
initial.missing: Positions this version names that are not in the list yet: {positions}
initial.finishEditing: Save or cancel the row you are editing before the next step
initial.next: Next: give the reason and send
initial.countLine: This initial package has {count, plural, one {# position holder} other {# position holders}} with this DOA version
